title: 6 Things God Does Before Elevation
paragraphs: 6 Things God Does Before Elevation

They think elevation is a blessing.
But they don’t see the breaking that comes first.

You want the platform.
God is preparing the person.
Here are 6 things God often does before elevation—and most people quit in the middle of them:

1. He isolates you.
Not to punish you—but to shape you.

Joseph was pulled away from family.
David was hidden in the fields.
Because crowds can’t build what solitude must form.

2. He exposes what you’ve been hiding.
Attitude. Motives. Secret sin.

Not to shame you—
but to cleanse you.

But here’s what we miss…
God won’t elevate what hasn’t been surrendered.

3. He lets you be overlooked.
You’re qualified. Ready. Faithful.
Still… not chosen.

Why?
Because elevation without humility becomes destruction.

David was anointed…
then sent back to the sheep.

4. He stretches your obedience.
Small instructions. Quiet tests.
No applause. No recognition.
Just: Will you still obey Me when no one sees?
Because public power is built on private surrender.

5. He allows pressure to reveal your core.
Betrayal. Delay. Confusion.
And suddenly—you meet the real you.

Peter thought he was strong…
until the fire exposed his fear.
But grace met him there.

6. He breaks your dependence on anything but Him.
Titles fade. People fail. Doors close.

So you finally say:
“Jesus… You’re enough.”
And that’s the moment elevation becomes safe.

Because elevation is not about going higher—
it’s about becoming ready.
And the Gospel is this:

You don’t earn your elevation.
You receive your identity.

Through Jesus Christ, your sin is forgiven,
your heart is made new,
and your calling is secured—not by performance,
but by grace.

If you’re in the crushing season right now…
don’t run.

God is not delaying you.
He is preparing you.
Stay. Submit. Surrender.

Your elevation is coming—
but your transformation matters more.
